author: harrykron
quote:
Totally disappointed. I didn't expect the game was like this at all I expected something else after 13 years waiting... 

I play GTA to play as a criminal... This shouldn't even be called GTA.

I'm a fan of GTA since GTA San Andreas. I bought San Andreas, Liberty city, GTA 4 and GTA V for all the platforms. 

The only good thing is that the world feels alive. But I repeat this is not GTA for me...
